title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Lasam National Agricultural School in the Municipality of Lasam, Province of Cagayan to Lasam Institute of Technology

text.en: Renaming of School. - The name of Lasam National Agricultural School in the Municipality of Lasam, Province of Cagayan is hereby changed to Lasam Institute of Technology.
Repealing Clause. - All laws, presidential decrees, executive orders, rules and regulations contrary to or inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect upon, its approval and after its publication in at least two newspapers of general circulation.
